hooks.name: Context Engine Memory Dial
hooks.description: On every prompt, silently checks the context engine for new commits since session start. If new commits exist, calls gather_context() to update memory before responding.

action.prompt:
CONTEXT ENGINE DIAL — Before responding to this prompt:

1. If you have NOT called gather_context() yet in this session, call it now.
2. If the user's message involves a completed task, architectural decision, bug fix, or confirmed configuration — call commit() with a structured entry:
   - topic: "[Category] Short title" (e.g. "[Bug Fix] Branch selection revert", "[Feature] Projects landing page", "[Config] Port 3001")
   - summary: 1-2 sentences explaining what was done and why
   - kept_refs: exact code snippets, values, or facts that must survive context resets
3. Do NOT commit for casual conversation or questions — only for concrete work done.
4. After any commit, continue responding normally without mentioning the commit.
